create_offload_manager_offload_mode: create an OffloadManager in offload mode to save and clear model layer weights to disk
create_offload_manager_clean_mode: create an OffloadManager in clean mode to clear weights and reload from original checkpoint files
offload_model_layers: offload multiple model layers to free CPU RAM and optionally trigger garbage collection
reload_offloaded_modules: reload previously offloaded model modules from disk or original checkpoint files
add_offload_hooks: add pre-forward hooks to transparently reload model modules on demand during inference
